def _reference_block(features, transform):
    block = {"center_reference_m": None, "bbox_reference_min_m": None,
             "bbox_reference_max_m": None}
    if not transform or transform.get("status") == "unknown":
        return block
    try:
        from core.calibration import apply_transform
    except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
        from calibration import apply_transform
    corners = np.array([
        [features["bbox_source_min_m"][0], features["bbox_source_min_m"][1], features["bbox_source_min_m"][2]],
        [features["bbox_source_max_m"][0], features["bbox_source_max_m"][1], features["bbox_source_max_m"][2]],
        [features["center_source_m"]],
    ])
    mapped = apply_transform(corners, transform)
    block["bbox_reference_min_m"] = [float(value) for value in np.minimum(
        mapped[0], mapped[1])]
    block["bbox_reference_max_m"] = [float(value) for value in np.maximum(
        mapped[0], mapped[1])]
    block["center_reference_m"] = [float(value) for value in mapped[2]]
    return block


def build_snapshot(points, settings=None, *, session_id, time_epoch, snapshot_id,
                   seq=None, stamp_secs=None, stamp_nsecs=None,
                   source_stamp_s=None, frame_id="innolidar", ground=None,
                   calibration=None, transform=None, background=None, note=None):
    """Build a versioned candidate snapshot from a decoded (N,3) point array.

    The snapshot is self-describing: session/time_epoch/snapshot_id, the raw
    source seq/sec/nsec it came from, frame and coordinate definitions, the
    calibration version, per-candidate geometry and the evidence indices. IDs
    are only unique inside this snapshot and never claim a tracked person.
    """
    resolved = resolve_settings(settings)
    array = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float64)
    if array.ndim != 2 or array.shape[1] != 3:
        raise ValueError("points must be an (N,3) array")
    finite = np.all(np.isfinite(array), axis=1)
    array = array[finite]
    original_indices = np.nonzero(finite)[0]
    if len(array) > resolved["max_points"]:
        stride = int(np.ceil(len(array) / resolved["max_points"]))
        array = array[::stride]
        original_indices = original_indices[::stride]

    ranges = np.linalg.norm(array, axis=1) if len(array) else np.zeros(0)
    keep = (ranges >= resolved["range_min_m"]) & (ranges <= resolved["range_max_m"])
    basis = ground_plane_basis(ground)
    if basis is not None and len(array):
        heights = array @ basis[0] + float(ground["offset_m"])
        keep &= (heights >= resolved["height_min_m"]) & (heights <= resolved["height_max_m"])
    array = array[keep]
    original_indices = original_indices[keep]

    if background is not None and len(array):
        fg = foreground_mask(array, background)
        array = array[fg]
        original_indices = original_indices[fg]

    horizontal = _horizontal_coords(array, basis) if len(array) else np.zeros((0, 2))
    clusters = _connected_clusters(horizontal, resolved["cluster_cell_m"]) if len(array) else []

    candidates = []
    for members in clusters:
        cluster_points = array[members]
        cluster_indices = original_indices[members]
        features = _point_features(cluster_points, basis, ground, resolved, cluster_indices)
        if not features["quality"]["sufficient_points"]:
            continue
        features.update(_reference_block(features, transform))
        features["semantic"] = "unknown"
        candidates.append(features)
    candidates.sort(key=lambda item: (round(item["center_source_m"][0], 6),
                                      round(item["center_source_m"][1], 6),
                                      round(item["center_source_m"][2], 6),
                                      item["point_count"]))
    for number, candidate in enumerate(candidates):
        candidate["candidate_id"] = "c{:04d}".format(number)

    coordinate = {
        "source_frame": frame_id,
        "reference_frame": (calibration or {}).get("frames", {}).get("reference")
        if calibration and calibration.get("frames", {}).get("reference") else None,
        "horizontal_basis": "ground_tangent" if basis is not None else "raw_xy_uncalibrated",
        "ground_relative_available": basis is not None,
        "ground_frame": ground.get("frame") if isinstance(ground, dict) else None,
        "transform_status": transform.get("status") if isinstance(transform, dict) else "unknown",
    }
    calibration_block = {
        "calibration_id": (calibration or {}).get("calibration_id"),
        "schema_version": (calibration or {}).get("schema_version"),
        "ground_status": ground.get("status") if isinstance(ground, dict) else "unknown",
    }
    quality = {
        "ground_valid": basis is not None,
        "background_applied": background is not None,
        "candidate_count": len(candidates),
        "input_point_count": int(len(array)),
        "coverage": ground_coverage(array, ground) if len(array) else
        {"available": False, "reason": "no_points", "projected_inside_fraction": None,
         "inside_count": 0, "point_count": 0},
        "reasons": [] if basis is not None else ["ground_unavailable"],
    }
    return {
        "kind": KIND,
        "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "session_id": session_id,
        "time_epoch": int(time_epoch),
        "snapshot_id": snapshot_id,
        "source": {
            "seq": seq,
            "stamp_secs": stamp_secs,
            "stamp_nsecs": stamp_nsecs,
            "source_stamp_s": None if source_stamp_s is None else float(source_stamp_s),
            "frame_id": frame_id,
        },
        "units": dict(UNITS),
        "coordinate": coordinate,
        "calibration": calibration_block,
        "ground": None if not isinstance(ground, dict) else {
            "status": ground.get("status"), "frame": ground.get("frame"),
            "normal": ground.get("normal"), "offset_m": ground.get("offset_m"),
            "sensor_height_m": ground.get("sensor_height_m"),
        },
        "settings": resolved,
        "quality": quality,
        "candidates": candidates,
        "note": note,
    }

    """Return a new browser-facing copy without the large offline-evidence arrays.

    The per-candidate ``evidence_indices`` list (one index per cluster point) is
    only useful for offline review, not for the web overlay, and dominates the
    ``/human_fall/candidates`` JSON size. This copies the snapshot and each
    candidate into fresh dicts and drops that one field, so the algorithm's
    cached/selection snapshot is never mutated and the same input still produces
    the same algorithm result. All other fields (ids, center, bbox, point_count,
    quality, source/session/epoch) are preserved.

            item = dict(candidate)
            item.pop("evidence_indices", None)
            candidates.append(item)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# HF-09 rollback-capable deploy/start/stop for the live human_fall node + page.
#
# Runs INSIDE the slam-localization container, with a ROS env already sourced
# (rospy / inno_lidar_msg come from the existing devel overlay). Each release
# stores an IMMUTABLE Python code bundle (core/scripts/config + a copy of the
# frozen point-cloud decoder) and the start/profile commands load `core` and the
# node ONLY from that bundle; the mutable devel working tree is never imported.
#
# Versions are kept under $BASE/releases/<utc>; rollback repoints symlinks and
# never deletes a release. Stopping kills only the exact recorded PID after
# verifying its full cmdline (node path AND config path); a mismatch refuses and
# exits non-zero, so no second node is ever started. The driver, the old
# homepage and the network are never touched.
set -euo pipefail

BASE="${HF_DEPLOY_BASE:-/root/catkin_ws/human_fall_deploy}"
RELEASES="$BASE/releases"
CURRENT="$BASE/current"
PID_DIR="$BASE/pids"
WEBUI_ROOT="/root/catkin_ws/webui"
WEBUI_LINK="$WEBUI_ROOT/human_fall"
WS="${HF_WS:-/root/catkin_ws/hf07_verify_ws}"
PKG_SRC="$WS/src/human_fall_detection"
HFC_SRC="${HF_HFC_SRC:-/root/catkin_ws/src/human_follow_calibration}"
NODE_PID="$PID_DIR/human_fall_node.pid"
NODE_CMD="$PID_DIR/human_fall_node.cmd"
PROFILE_PID="$PID_DIR/profile.pid"

log() { printf '%s\n' "$*"; }

_resolve_current() {
  [ -L "$CURRENT" ] || { log "no current release; run: $0 release"; exit 3; }
  readlink -f "$CURRENT"
}

_pid_cmdline() {
  [ -n "${1:-}" ] && [ -r "/proc/$1/cmdline" ] && tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$1/cmdline" || true
}

_bundle_pythonpath() {
  printf '%s' "$1/bundle:$1/bundle/scripts:$1/bundle/human_follow_calibration/scripts:${PYTHONPATH:-}"
}

# Fail unless the bundle's core is the one Python actually imports.
_verify_bundle_import() {
  local dir="$1" core_file
  core_file="$(PYTHONPATH="$(_bundle_pythonpath "$dir")" python3 -c 'import core; print(core.__file__)' 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "$core_file" in
    "$dir"/bundle/core/*) log "bundle core OK: $core_file" ;;
    *) log "REFUSING: core resolves outside release bundle: ${core_file:-<none>}"; return 1 ;;
  esac
}

_kill_pidfile() {
  local file="$1" cmd_file="$2" expect_node="$3" expect_cfg="$4" pid cmd stored
  [ -f "$file" ] || { log "no pidfile $file"; return 0; }
  pid="$(cat "$file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -z "$pid" ] || [ ! -d "/proc/$pid" ]; then
    log "stale/missing pid $pid in $file"; rm -f "$file" "$cmd_file"; return 0
  fi
  cmd="$(_pid_cmdline "$pid")"
  if [ -f "$cmd_file" ]; then
    stored="$(cat "$cmd_file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    expect_node="${stored%%|*}"; expect_cfg="${stored##*|}"
  fi
  case "$cmd" in
    *"$expect_node"*"$expect_cfg"*)
      log "stopping pid $pid"; kill "$pid"
      for _ in $(seq 1 25); do [ -d "/proc/$pid" ] || break; sleep 0.2; done
      if [ -d "/proc/$pid" ]; then log "pid $pid still alive; SIGKILL"; kill -9 "$pid"; sleep 0.3; fi
      if [ -d "/proc/$pid" ]; then log "REFUSING: pid $pid did not exit"; return 1; fi ;;
    *) log "REFUSING to kill pid $pid: cmdline does not match node+config"; return 1 ;;
  esac
  rm -f "$file" "$cmd_file"
}

_stop_node() { _kill_pidfile "$NODE_PID" "$NODE_CMD" "$1/bundle/scripts/human_fall_node.py" "$1/bundle/config/human_fall_prod.yaml"; }

release() {
  local stamp; stamp="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
  local dir="$RELEASES/$stamp" tmp="$RELEASES/.${stamp}.tmp.$$"
  local webui_src="${WEBUI_SRC:-$BASE/src/webui/human_fall}"
  [ -d "$webui_src" ] || { log "missing page source dir $webui_src"; exit 7; }
  if [ -e "$CURRENT" ] && [ ! -L "$CURRENT" ]; then log "REFUSING: $CURRENT is not a symlink"; exit 4; fi
  if [ -e "$WEBUI_LINK" ] && [ ! -L "$WEBUI_LINK" ]; then log "REFUSING: $WEBUI_LINK is not a symlink"; exit 4; fi
  mkdir -p "$tmp/bundle" "$tmp/webui"
  mkdir -p "$tmp/bundle/core" "$tmp/bundle/scripts" "$tmp/bundle/config" \
           "$tmp/bundle/human_follow_calibration/scripts"
  cp -a "$PKG_SRC"/core/*.py "$tmp/bundle/core/"
  cp -a "$PKG_SRC"/scripts/*.py "$tmp/bundle/scripts/"
  cp -a "$PKG_SRC"/config/*.yaml "$tmp/bundle/config/"
  if [ -f "$HFC_SRC/scripts/calibrate_human_follow.py" ]; then
    cp -a "$HFC_SRC"/scripts/*.py "$tmp/bundle/human_follow_calibration/scripts/"
  else
    log "REFUSING: frozen decoder not found at $HFC_SRC/scripts"; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit 7
  fi
  cp -a "$webui_src" "$tmp/webui/human_fall"
  ( cd "$tmp/bundle" && find . -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum ) > "$tmp/bundle/manifest.sha256"
  ( cd "$PKG_SRC" && find . -type f -not -path '*__pycache__*' -print0 \
      | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum ) > "$tmp/source.sha256"
  if ! _verify_bundle_import "$tmp"; then rm -rf "$tmp"; exit 5; fi
  mv "$tmp" "$dir"
  ln -sfn "$dir" "$CURRENT"
  ln -sfn "$dir/webui/human_fall" "$WEBUI_LINK"
  log "released $dir (current -> $stamp); bundle core+scripts+config+decoder stored"
}

start() {
  local dir; dir="$(_resolve_current)"
  [ -f "$dir/bundle/scripts/human_fall_node.py" ] || { log "release has no code bundle (legacy); refusing"; exit 5; }
  _verify_bundle_import "$dir" >/dev/null || { log "bundle import check failed; not starting"; exit 5; }
  mkdir -p "$PID_DIR"
  _stop_node "$dir" || { log "existing node not stopped; refusing to start a second"; exit 1; }
  local node="$dir/bundle/scripts/human_fall_node.py"
  local cfg="$dir/bundle/config/human_fall_prod.yaml"
  local perc="$dir/bundle/config/perception.yaml"
  PYTHONPATH="$(_bundle_pythonpath "$dir")" nohup setsid python3 "$node" \
    --config "$cfg" --perception "$perc" > "$dir/run.log" 2>&1 &
  echo $! > "$NODE_PID"
  printf '%s|%s' "$node" "$cfg" > "$NODE_CMD"
  log "started human_fall_node pid $(cat "$NODE_PID") from bundle $(basename "$dir")"
}

profile() {
  local dir; dir="$(_resolve_current)"; local duration="${1:-1800}"
  [ -f "$dir/bundle/scripts/profile_pipeline.py" ] || { log "release has no bundle profiler"; exit 5; }
  local pid; pid="$(cat "$NODE_PID" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  mkdir -p "$PID_DIR"
  PYTHONPATH="$(_bundle_pythonpath "$dir")" nohup setsid python3 \
    "$dir/bundle/scripts/profile_pipeline.py" \
    --duration "$duration" --note-pid "${pid:-0}" --label "live" \
    --mode "human_fall_prod.yaml (ground=unavailable, confirmed-off) bundle=$(basename "$dir")" \
    --output "$dir/profile_rows.jsonl" --summary "$dir/profile_summary.json" \
    > "$dir/profile.log" 2>&1 &
  echo $! > "$PROFILE_PID"
  log "profiling pid $(cat "$PROFILE_PID") for ${duration}s -> $dir/profile_summary.json"
}

stop() {
  _kill_pidfile "$PROFILE_PID" "" "profile_pipeline.py" "" || return 1
  local dir; dir="$(_resolve_current 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -n "$dir" ]; then _stop_node "$dir" || return 1; fi
  log "stopped (driver untouched)"
}

status() {
  local dir; dir="$(_resolve_current 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
  log "current release: $dir"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# One-time transition: stop the R1 node started by the OLD deploy (direct devel
# wrapper, no bundle) so the new bundle-based script can own the pidfile. Only
# matches a human_fall node whose config is under human_fall_deploy/releases/.
set -u
PIDF=/root/catkin_ws/human_fall_deploy/pids/human_fall_node.pid
PROF=/root/catkin_ws/human_fall_deploy/pids/profile.pid
for f in "$PROF" "$PIDF"; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  pid="$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [ -n "$pid" ] && [ -d "/proc/$pid" ] || { rm -f "$f"; continue; }
  cmd="$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "$cmd" in
    *human_fall_deploy/releases/*human_fall_prod.yaml*|*profile_pipeline.py*)
      echo "stopping $pid: $cmd"
      kill "$pid"; for _ in $(seq 1 25); do [ -d "/proc/$pid" ] || break; sleep 0.2; done
      [ -d "/proc/$pid" ] && kill -9 "$pid"
      rm -f "$f" ;;
    *) echo "skip $pid (not this task's release process): $cmd" ;;
  esac
done
echo "--- remaining ---"
ps -eo pid,args | grep -E "[h]uman_fall_node|[p]rofile_pipeline|[i]nno_lidar_node" || true

Actual `start(C)→rollback(B)→start` works; legacy no-bundle rollback refused (exit 6, pointers unchanged); atomic release with symlink pre-checks; no deletion/pkill.
